title: Nourishing Tender Egyptian Chicken Curry
description: A cultured and indulgent Egyptian dish featuring panang paste and coconut cream, this recipe is a must try for those who love tender chicken in a rich and creamy sauce. It is also kosher friendly.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute.
Add the chicken to the pan and cook until it is browned on all sides.
Add the panang paste to the pan and stir to combine.
Pour in the coconut cream and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the curry simmer for 20 minutes.
Season the curry with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the curry hot over rice or with naan bread.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
